about.title: About GOSTA TRANS
about.presentation: GOSTA TRANS LOGISTICS & BTP is a Central African company based in Bangui, headquartered at SICA II with two operating sites on Boali Road (PK14 and PK20). It brings together under one structure materials transport, equipment rental with operator and construction works, from structural to finishing works.
about.methode: Every request follows the same thread: receiving the need, mobilising resources (trucks, equipment, teams), then supervised execution on site. This continuity between logistics and construction limits delays caused by supply breaks.
about.engagement: The team works on individual houses as well as residential, commercial or industrial buildings, and on roadworks and urban sanitation projects, with the reliability of a single point of contact from start to finish.

comments.quote: Materials delivery and coffered ceiling installation handled by the same team, without having to coordinate several providers.
The team mobilises equipment quickly when an unexpected issue delays the schedule — that's what you expect from a logistics partner.
A single point of contact from materials transport to roadworks, which greatly simplifies site monitoring.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about our transport, equipment rental and construction services. Still have a question? Contact us directly.
faq.ctaText: Can't find the answer to your question?

items.question: How do I get a quote?
items.answer: Fill in the "Get a quote" form on the site or write to us directly on WhatsApp describing your need (transport, equipment rental or construction works). We get back to you within 24 business hours with a tailored estimate.

items.question: Which areas do you cover?
items.answer: We mainly operate in Bangui and its surrounding area, from our three sites: the SICA II headquarters (2nd district) and our two operating sites at PK14 and PK20 on Boali Road. For a site outside this area, contact us to check feasibility.

items.question: What kind of equipment do you rent out?
items.answer: Our fleet covers common site needs: trucks for materials transport, earthmoving and handling equipment, with a qualified operator included. Available equipment details are shared with you at quote stage.

items.question: Do you offer both transport and construction works?
items.answer: Yes, that's what sets us apart: GOSTA TRANS brings together materials transport, equipment rental and construction works, from structural to finishing works, under one structure. A single point of contact follows your project from start to finish.

items.question: What are your response times?
items.answer: Timelines depend on the nature of the request (one-off transport, equipment rental or a full construction project). We give you a precise timeline once we've reviewed your request, generally within 24 business hours.

items.question: What are your hours and how can I reach you?
items.answer: Our team is available Monday to Saturday, 07:30 to 18:00, by phone, WhatsApp or email. Outside these hours, leave us a message: we'll reply as soon as we're back.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: Payment terms (deposit, installments, payment on delivery or on completion of works) are agreed together at quote stage, depending on the nature and duration of the service.

items.question: Do you work with individuals and companies?
items.answer: Yes, we work with individuals (private houses) as well as companies, property developers and public institutions, on residential, commercial, industrial or roadworks projects.
